meta.title: Accommodation | Villa Mandara
meta.description: Rent the whole of Villa Mandara — 4 bedrooms, up to 9 guests, pool and sauna, in complete privacy. In-season and off-season rates.

hero.title: Villa Mandara, entirely yours
hero.lead: The whole villa just for your group — 4 bedrooms, up to 9 guests, a pool, a sauna and common areas in complete privacy. The villa is rented as a whole, not by the room.

villa.title: The whole villa — just for you
villa.lead: Rent the entire villa and have it all to yourself — the bedrooms, the shared living room, the kitchen, the pool, the sauna and the garden, in complete calm and privacy for your group.
villa.exclusivity: The whole villa just for your group — complete privacy, with no shared spaces.

includes.garden: Garden and terraces with a view

rooms.title: The rooms of the villa
rooms.lead: Each bedroom bears the name of a moment of the day and its own herb — all part of the whole villa, made for restful sleep.
